newsitem.title: MEXICO: BASEBALL-VENEZUELA BEATS PUERTO RICO AT CARIBBEAN SERIES.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-VENEZUELA BEATS PUERTO RICO AT CARIBBEAN SERIES.

text.p: Eddie Diaz drove in five runs with a three-run pinch-hit home run and a two-run single to lift Venezuela to a 14-7 win over Puerto Rico Thursday in the Caribbean Baseball Series.
The result left both teams with 2-1 records after three games in the round-robin tournament.
Venezuela, represented by Magallanes Navigators, pounded out 20 hits including three home runs, and scored in clusters -- three runs in the second inning, four in the sixth and five in the seventh.
Andy Abad also had a three-run homer for Venezuela.
Puerto Rico, represented by the Mayaquez Indians, had 13 hits, including three home runs.
The winning pitcher was Juan Carlos Pulido and the loser was Rafael Montalvo.

In the second game, Alex Arias's three-run home run capped a five-run fifth inning to help the Dominican Republic score its first victory of the tournament, 9-6 over defending champion Mexico. Both teams are 1-2.
Tony Batista had four runs batted in for the Dominicans, represented by Aguilas Cibaenas, who rapped out 11 hits. Mexico, represented by Culican Tomato Growers, had six hits, two of them home runs.
On Friday, the fourth day of play, the Dominican Republic meets Puerto Rico and Mexico plays Venezuela.
